statement: The repository records that during the 2026-06-07 server-restart instability, a byte-identical refusal reply went out to the same Telegram topic five times within 19 seconds because the in-memory OutboundContentDedup fingerprint map is per-process and resets on restart, exactly the window the restart churn opened.
subject: self

entities.name: durable cross-restart outbound content dedup store

statement: src/messaging/OutboundDedupStore.ts added a durable, SQLite-backed dedup fingerprint store surviving server restarts and overlapping processes, deliberately fail-open by construction so that a missing, locked, corrupt or native-binding-broken database degrades to no-signal rather than ever blocking or dropping a legitimate reply.
subject: self

statement: src/messaging/DeliveryRetryManager.ts implements three layered continuity responsibilities per spec Phase 3: Layer 1 exponential-backoff retry (server unreachable, up to a 4-hour window), a post-injection watchdog that verifies the tmux session survived, and TTL expiry that moves expired messages to a dead-letter path and escalates critical/alert messages to Telegram.
subject: self

statement: src/messaging/stuckMessageRecovery.ts implements the no-loss half of exactly-once ingress (spec section 8, G3a): an inbound event claimed but never reply-committed (holder crashed or fenced mid-turn) is re-run by the current lease holder from the ledger's stored input, bounded by a max-processing timeout and a max-replay-attempt cap so a legitimately unanswered message is not replayed forever.
subject: self

statement: src/threadline/SpawnLedger.ts (a SQLite CAS ledger whose tryReserve() atomically claims a spawn eventId, making a duplicate relay-spawn structurally impossible) and HeartbeatWatchdog.ts (a shared 1s heartbeat poller against that ledger) implement Components A/B of the Relay-Spawn Ghost-Reply Containment Spec; the watchdog is a pure signal-producer, never killing or retrying itself.
subject: self

entities.name: agent-to-agent warm session pool (TTL + LRU eviction)

statement: src/threadline/WarmSessionPool.ts is the pure registry-and-eviction-policy Layer 2 core of the Threadline A2A Coherence Spec: a per-peer, global-plus-per-peer-capped, TTL-plus-LRU pool that keeps an agent-to-agent session warm so rapid follow-ups inject into the running session, with eviction reported as lossless because the next message falls back to Layer 1 resume.
subject: self

statement: src/threadline/CircuitBreaker.ts implements a per-agent circuit breaker for inter-agent communication (Threadline Protocol Phase 5, section 7.9): 5 consecutive errors open the circuit and queue rather than deliver messages, an open circuit auto-resets after 1 hour via half-open, and 3 breaks in 24 hours auto-downgrades trust to untrusted.
subject: self

statement: src/server/WebSocketManager.ts implements real-time terminal streaming for the dashboard over a typed JSON protocol (subscribe/unsubscribe/history/input/key/ping client messages, diff-based output server messages) so a dashboard client can attach to and interact with a live tmux session.
subject: self

statement: src/server/AgentServer.ts is the Express-based HTTP server core providing health checks, session management, job triggering and event querying over REST, and also serves the dashboard UI and WebSocket connections for real-time terminal streaming.
subject: self

statement: src/providers/costAwareRouting.ts implements the repository's declared routing default for Anthropic-bound traffic per specs/provider-portability/04-anthropic-path-constraints.md: prefer the prepaid SDK-credit path first, fall back to the subscription REPL pool as the always-available floor once SDK credit drops below a configurable safety margin (default 10%), and never default to raw API.
subject: self

statement: src/monitoring/PresenceProxy.ts monitors the gap between a user's Telegram message and the agent's response and posts tiered, LLM-generated standby status updates (Haiku at 20s and 2min, Sonnet at 5min to assess genuine stuckness); its own proxy messages are explicitly excluded from counting as agent responses for the separate StallDetector.
subject: self

statement: src/monitoring/TokenLedgerPoller.ts periodically drives TokenLedger.scanAll() to keep a SQLite rollup of Claude Code token usage current, tracking byte offsets per JSONL transcript file so repeated scans are idempotent; it is read-only observability that never mutates the source transcripts.
subject: self

entities.name: LlmQueue shared priority-laned LLM call queue

statement: src/monitoring/LlmQueue.ts was extracted from PresenceProxy per PROMISE-BEACON-SPEC.md Phase 1 into a shared priority-laned LLM call queue (interactive vs background lanes with a reservation rule) so that when the interactive lane needs a slot at the provider concurrency limit, the lowest-priority in-flight background call is aborted via AbortController rather than the interactive caller waiting.
subject: self
